import sympy as sp

A = sp.Matrix([
    [2, 3],
    [4, 7]
])

L = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 0],
    [2, 1]
])

U = sp.Matrix([
    [2, 3],
    [0, 1]
])

print("L * U =")
sp.pprint(L * U)

print("\nA^(-1) =")
sp.pprint(A.inv())

print("\nA * A^(-1) =")
sp.pprint(A * A.inv())
